earthworks_m3.description: Cut/fill/regrade of street or ground (volume of |dz| x area)

floodwall_low_m_per_m.unit: m length per m height (h<=1.2 m)
floodwall_low_m_per_m.source: LSU AgCenter - Flood Barrier and Protection; LSU AgCenter Pub 2745 floodwall
floodwall_low_m_per_m.quote: Floodwalls average $150 per linear foot plus labor to install. The typical cost of a basic 4-foot floodwall was about $120 per linear foot in 1998.
floodwall_low_m_per_m.derived: LSU AgCenter $150/lf at ~4 ft (1.22 m) -> $492/m / 1.22 m = $403 per m per m height

floodwall_high_m_per_m.unit: m length per m height (h>=2.5 m)
floodwall_high_m_per_m.source: USACE North Atlantic Coast Comprehensive Study (NACCS) Appendix C Parametric Costs, Sec VIII Coastal Storm Risk Management Measures
floodwall_high_m_per_m.quote: For a 10 foot high floodwall construction, first construction costs are about $5,335 per linear foot; annualized costs are about $237 per linear foot.
floodwall_high_m_per_m.derived: $5,335/lf for 10 ft -> $17,503/m / 3.05 m = $5,739 per m per m height

FloodBreak: 6' x 3' pedestrian gate $14,000; 25' x 3' vehicle gate $70,000. Boston: passive barriers $10,000 per square meter, useful life 50-100 years; modular interlocking panels $50-$100 per square foot.

tunnel_m_ref.unit: m length at D=9.9 m (scaled linearly with diameter, min D 3 m)

tunnel_m_ref.quote: For a single representative 10-mile tunnel section, the cost to design and build is estimated to be in the range of $3-$4 billion ... $300 million to $400 million per mile, or $57,000 to $76,000 per linear foot.
